title: I’m a plumber in mall world and I don’t like it
content: I think I might be responsible for repairing the damaging effects of other people’s dreams on the world. I have only had one dream in my life that I would describe as “horrible” And it wasn’t even a nightmare. It was a bathroom. A GIGANTIC bathroom. Two rows of walls ran down through the central area, about twenty five feet across each, with a row of stalls on each side of both. The exterior wall was lined with urinals, a rectangle about 50x25 feet in total. There’s a wall of sinks visible from the doorway, and the actual bathroom can be entered through openings at each end of the walls. Biggest bathroom I’ve ever seen. So that’s what it NORMALLY looks like. It was destroyed. Like a group came through with sledgehammers. Not a single toilet was intact, no urinals on the walls, and apparently I’m the only one who knows how to turn the water off because every single opening was spraying, the janitors had those yellow blockade things set up on either side as they struggled to fight the flood as it overflowed like a waterfall into that central area, I don’t know how many floors up we were but it felt high. I spent my entire night loading shards of porcelain into a gondola, setting toilets, soldering piping, mounting urinals, and installing pedestal sinks. I only have dreams about working in mall world. I don’t have the fun mall dreams other people talk about. All I do is chase down leaks. I spent two years as a plumber in real life, but I’ve been a sprinkler fitter for the past seven. I know how to do all the things I dream about (there) in real life. Does anyone else have a job at mall world that they do not particularly enjoy? Does anyone else with a job ONLY dream of working? And on a final note STOP FUCKING UP THE BATHROOMS
